edges.reason: Constructor derives owner and initial balances from _msgSender().
Untrusted msg.sender becomes the from address of the internal transfer.
block.timestamp drives the cooldown comparison and cooldown write inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap deadline in openTrading.
manualswap authorization is a direct comparison of _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization is a direct comparison of _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
transfer forwards execution to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
transferFrom forwards execution to _transfer before adjusting allowance.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth (external call) before finalizing user balances.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which performs external ETH transfers.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping based on block.timestamp.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for sender and recipient.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit when cooldown is enabled.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard before triggering the automatic swap.
swapTokensForEth forwards tokenAmount and path into the router swap call.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router to build the path and perform the swap.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through the _allowances mapping.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to the fee wallet via an external transfer call.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading passes the contract balance and owner into addLiquidityETH.
openTrading writes the newly created pair address into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading passes owner() as the liquidity recipient.
openTrading assigns the hardcoded router address to uniswapV2Router.
Constructor writes the deployer address into _owner via the Ownable constructor.
Constructor sets _feeAddrWallet1 and marks it fee-exempt.
setBots writes each supplied address into the bots blacklist.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading raises _maxTxAmount to the new trading limit.
The external router swap can execute token callbacks that re-enter _transfer.
The external ETH transfer can re-enter sendETHToFee or its caller.
from parameter feeds the bot checks, cooldown and pair comparisons in _transfer.
to parameter feeds the cooldown, blacklist and pair comparisons in _transfer.
amount parameter is validated and used to compute fee values.
recipient parameter of transfer is forwarded into _transfer.
sender parameter of transferFrom is forwarded into _transfer and allowance checks.
tokenAmount parameter defines how many tokens are swapped for ETH.
amount parameter is split in half and pushed to both fee wallets.
bots_ array parameter elements are written into the bots mapping.
contractTokenBalance local is passed as the swap amount to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance local is passed as the amount to sendETHToFee.
path local array is supplied to the router swap call.
Local router instance is used to call addLiquidityETH in openTrading.

normalization_plan.reason: from is the sender parameter consumed directly by _transfer.
to is the recipient parameter consumed directly by _transfer.
amount is the value parameter validated and processed by _transfer.
recipient is the destination parameter of the transfer entrypoint.
sender is the source parameter of the transferFrom entrypoint.
tokenAmount is the swap size parameter of swapTokensForEth.
amount is the ETH amount parameter distributed by sendETHToFee.
bots_ is the address array parameter iterated by setBots.
The local balance is the input amount supplied to swapTokensForEth.
The local ETH balance is the input amount supplied to sendETHToFee.
The path array is constructed for and consumed by the swapTokensForEth router call.
The local router instance exists only inside openTrading to initialize the router and pair.
